name: 1. Setup Ubuntu
description: First contact with a freshly installed robot: SSH and sudo check, Ubuntu prerequisites (Lite robots), enrolment in the inventory. Seconds to 2 minutes. Safe to re-run.

survey_vars.name: robot_address
survey_vars.title: Robot address
survey_vars.description: IP or DNS name, for example 192.168.1.21 or robotont-123.local

survey_vars.name: robotont_id
survey_vars.title: Robot number
survey_vars.description: 1 to 254: becomes hostname robotont-N, ROS_DOMAIN_ID N and hotspot 192.168.200.N

survey_vars.name: robotont_camera
survey_vars.title: Camera
survey_vars.description: IMX500 AI camera fitted (Lite robots only)

name: 2. Setup ROS
description: Upstream robotont-setup on one enrolled robot: ROS 2 Jazzy, workspace build, hostname, Wi-Fi hotspot, robotont.service, reboot. 20 to 60 minutes, robot on Ethernet.

survey_vars.name: robotont_id
survey_vars.title: Robot number
survey_vars.description: a robot enrolled by 1. Setup Ubuntu

name: 3. Switch preset
description: Container runtime (docs/07): activate a preset on one robot. Needs playbooks/setup_docker.yml on that robot first.

survey_vars.name: preset
survey_vars.title: Preset
survey_vars.description: host = ROS installed on the robot; the others run in containers
